subject: RFP: Benchmark credits & short-term trial extension for Horizon Health bake-off
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@horizon-health.io>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: RFP: Benchmark credits & short-term trial extension for Horizon Health bake-off

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the call earlier — great to hear more about Horizon's evaluation plan for the RFP. Based on what you shared (multi-model bake-off, ~50k messages over 2 weeks, mix of clinical and patient-facing prompts), we can offer the following to make the comparison simpler:

- 250,000 free token-equivalent eval credits usable on our hosted API (valid for 90 days)
- A complimentary 30-day trial extension for your engineering sandbox (adds private model routing to emulate your infra)
- A short mutual action plan (attached) that lays out timelines, success criteria, and a single-point contact for support

I've attached a one-page proposal and an MAP (mutual_action_plan.xlsx). If that looks good, we can fast-track an EULA addendum and provide a DocuSign link for procurement.

Two quick asks: can you confirm whether your procurement team needs SOC 2 evidence before credits are issued, and do you want the credits scoped to hosted-only or to include our Dedicated tier for latency testing?

Available for a 30-min sync Thursday morning PST if you'd like to align on tech/process.

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-eval-credit-proposal.pdf (1 page), mutual_action_plan.xlsx (staged)
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@horizon-health.io>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@horizon-health.io, Mark Donovan <mark.donovan@health-consult.com>
Date: 2026-10-16T11:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP: Benchmark credits & short-term trial extension for Horizon Health bake-off

Hi Tessa —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the clear proposal. A couple of clarifying points from procurement and our SRE lead:

- Procurement: we will need SOC 2 Type II evidence and a short data handling summary before formal acceptance of credits.
- Architecture/SRE (Mark): can the eval credits be applied to both hosted and Dedicated environments? We'll want to do latency-sensitive runs on a Dedicated-like config.
- Timing: our bake-off window is Nov 9–20; the 30-day extension sounds helpful but does the credit expiration line up with that window?

If you can confirm SOC2 doc availability and whether the credits cover Dedicated, we can route this through procurement next week.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Director, Digital Platforms
Horizon Health

Tessa —

Copying legal/ops thread owners for awareness. Quick internal recommendation:

- Approve 250K eval credits (as proposed) and allow usage across hosted + Dedicated demo instances (limited to Dedicated dev pool; production Dedicated requires contract commit)
- Provide SOC 2 Type II artifact and a 1-page data handling summary (both available from Compliance; I'll attach the SOC pack once I hear from security)
- Have sales ops issue credits tied to DEAL-2026-4591 and set an expiration 120 days from issuance (covers their Nov bake-off comfortably)

Priya: can you prep the DocuSign EULA addendum and quick billing note? Monica: please prepare the SOC2 extract for external sharing (redacted as needed).

If you want, I'll greenlight now so Tessa can respond to procurement.

—Rishi

Hi Elena —

Great news: Sales Ops approved the proposal. Summary of what we'll deliver:

- 250,000 eval credits (issued to your project code) usable on hosted API and on our Dedicated demo pool for latency runs

Best,
